recipe.title: Garlic Sautéed Chicken and Broccoli
recipe.description: A quick and healthy stir-fry featuring tender chicken breast and crisp broccoli florets sautéed with fresh garlic and olive oil.
instructions: Cut the chicken breast into bite-sized strips and season with salt and pepper.
Heat half of the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken to the skillet and cook until browned and fully cooked through, approximately 6-8 minutes. Remove chicken from the pan and set aside.
Add the remaining olive oil to the same pan. Add the broccoli florets and a splash of water, cover, and steam for 3-4 minutes until tender-crisp.
Uncover, add the minced garlic, and stir-fry for 1 minute until fragrant.
Return the chicken to the pan, toss everything together for 1 minute to combine, and serve immediately.
